title: This Animal Has 24 Eyes and No Brain, and Its Sting Can Kill in Minutes

scenes.text: This animal has 24 eyes and no brain.
It's the box jellyfish, and it hunts anyway.
It swims at about four and a half knots, like an Olympic swimmer.
It has 60 tentacles, each around eight feet long.
Its venom is among the deadliest known, and one part stops the heart.
Scientists still can't explain how it sees without a brain.

description:
This animal has 24 eyes and no brain.
The box jellyfish swims at about four and a half knots, has 60 tentacles, and its venom can kill a person in minutes.
Could you hunt with no brain?
